rows.note: Use 蟹 as the all-purpose noun for a true crab and, in ordinary speech, for crab-like varieties.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 haai5 hou2 daai6 zek3 wo3

rows.note: Use 蟹肉 when referring to the meat as food rather than to the animal.

example.english: This crab meat is really fresh and sweet.
example.jyutping: ni1 dip6 haai5 juk6 hou2 sin1 tim4

rows.note: Use 燥底 as a noun for a person characterized by a bad temper.

example.english: They’re a real crab, blowing up over the smallest things.
example.traditional: 佢真係個燥底，少少事就發脾氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 cou3 dai2 siu2 siu2 si6 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3
